answer: Stake a scarce physical token before an agent may bid. One: each newcomer posts a copper-bound hardware attestation that a trusted oracle verifies against a violet-sealed manufacturer certificate. Two: the oracle emits a one-time signal on-ledger that unlocks bidding for that key only. Three: clones without distinct hardware fail the check and stay mute. A thousand sybils need a thousand real chips, so identity cost scales with silicon, not with free accounts.
